title: Exactness of the associated graded forces exactness of the filtered complex
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a complex of filtered objects with finite filtrations whose associated graded is exact is itself exact, with exactness also of the filtration steps and of the successive quotients, and with both maps strict (statement lines 5311-5328). The proof is a complete argument: part (1) is read off the definitions, part (3) is proved by induction on the length of the filtrations with a commutative diagram of short exact sequences carrying the induction step (proof lines 5332-5351), the dual assertion for the filtration steps gives exactness of the complex, and strictness is obtained by identifying the image of each filtration step with the appropriate kernel (proof lines 5354-5361). The non-formal content is the induction and the strictness computation. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
